# ALMA Data Reduction Script

# Calibration

thesteps = []
step_title = {0: 'Import of the ASDM',
              1: 'Fix of SYSCAL table times',
              2: 'listobs',
              3: 'A priori flagging',
              4: 'Generation and time averaging of the WVR cal table',
              5: 'Generation of the Tsys cal table',
              6: 'Generation of the antenna position cal table',
              7: 'Application of the WVR, Tsys and antpos cal tables',
              8: 'Split out science SPWs and time average',
              9: 'Listobs, clear pointing table, and save original flags',
              10: 'Initial flagging',
              11: 'Putting a model for the flux calibrator(s)',
              12: 'Save flags before bandpass cal',
              13: 'Bandpass calibration',
              14: 'Save flags before gain cal',
              15: 'Gain calibration',
              16: 'Save flags before applycal',
              17: 'Application of the bandpass and gain cal tables',
              18: 'Split out corrected column',
              19: 'Save flags after applycal'}

if 'applyonly' not in globals(): applyonly = False
try:
  print 'List of steps to be executed ...', mysteps
  thesteps = mysteps
except:
  print 'global variable mysteps not set.'
if (thesteps==[]):
  thesteps = range(0,len(step_title))
  print 'Executing all steps: ', thesteps

# The Python variable 'mysteps' will control which steps
# are executed when you start the script using
#   execfile('scriptForCalibration.py')
# e.g. setting
#   mysteps = [2,3,4]# before starting the script will make the script execute
# only steps 2, 3, and 4
# Setting mysteps = [] will make it execute all steps.

import re

import os

if applyonly != True: es = aU.stuffForScienceDataReduction() 


if re.search('^4.3.1', casadef.casa_version) == None:
 sys.exit('ERROR: PLEASE USE THE SAME VERSION OF CASA THAT YOU USED FOR GENERATING THE SCRIPT: 4.3.1')


# CALIBRATE_AMPLI: J1337-129
# CALIBRATE_ATMOSPHERE: J1337-1257,J1337-129,RX_J1347.5-1145
# CALIBRATE_BANDPASS: J1337-1257
# CALIBRATE_FLUX: J1337-129
# CALIBRATE_FOCUS: 
# CALIBRATE_PHASE: J1337-1257
# CALIBRATE_POINTING: J1337-1257
# OBSERVE_TARGET: RX_J1347.5-1145

# Using reference antenna = DA64

# Import of the ASDM
mystep = 0
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  if os.path.exists('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms') == False:
    importasdm('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7', asis='Antenna Station Receiver Source CalAtmosphere CalWVR', bdfflags=True, lazy=False)
  if applyonly != True: es.fixForCSV2555('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms')

# Fix of SYSCAL table times
mystep = 1
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  from recipes.almahelpers import fixsyscaltimes
  fixsyscaltimes(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms')

print "# A priori calibration"

# listobs
mystep = 2
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.listobs')
  listobs(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    listfile = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.listobs')
  
  

# A priori flagging
mystep = 3
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    mode = 'manual',
    spw = '1~20',
    autocorr = T,
    flagbackup = F)
  
  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    mode = 'manual',
    intent = '*POINTING*,*SIDEBAND_RATIO*,*ATMOSPHERE*',
    flagbackup = F)
  
  flagcmd(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    inpmode = 'table',
    useapplied = True,
    action = 'plot',
    plotfile = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.flagcmd.png')
  
  flagcmd(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    inpmode = 'table',
    useapplied = True,
    action = 'apply')
  

# Generation and time averaging of the WVR cal table
mystep = 4
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr') 
  
  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvrgcal') 
  
  mylogfile = casalog.logfile()
  casalog.setlogfile('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvrgcal')
  
  wvrgcal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr',
    spw = [9, 11, 13, 15],
    smooth = '2.016s',
    toffset = 0,
    tie = ['RX_J1347.5-1145,J1337-1257'],
    statsource = 'RX_J1347.5-1145')
  
  casalog.setlogfile(mylogfile)
  
  if applyonly != True: aU.plotWVRSolutions(caltable='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr', spw='9', antenna='DA64',
    yrange=[-199,199],subplot=22, interactive=False,
    figfile='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr.plots/uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr') 
  
  #Note: If you see wraps in these plots, try changing yrange or unwrap=True 
  #Note: If all plots look strange, it may be a bad WVR on the reference antenna.
  #      To check, you can set antenna='' to show all baselines.
  

# Generation of the Tsys cal table
mystep = 5
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys') 
  gencal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys',
    caltype = 'tsys')
  
  # Flagging edge channels
  
  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys',
    mode = 'manual',
    spw = '9:0~3;124~127,11:0~3;124~127,13:0~3;124~127,15:0~3;124~127',
    flagbackup = F)
  
  if applyonly != True: aU.plotbandpass(caltable='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys', overlay='time', 
    xaxis='freq', yaxis='amp', subplot=22, buildpdf=False, interactive=False,
    showatm=True,pwv='auto',chanrange='92.1875%',showfdm=True, showBasebandNumber=True, 
    field='', figfile='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys.plots.overlayTime/uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys') 
  
  
  if applyonly != True: es.checkCalTable('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys', msName='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms', interactive=False)

# Application of the WVR, Tsys and antpos cal tables
mystep = 7
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  
  
  from recipes.almahelpers import tsysspwmap
  tsysmap = tsysspwmap(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms', tsystable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys', tsysChanTol = 1)
  
  
  
  applycal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    field = '0',
    spw = '9,11,13,15',
    gaintable = ['uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys', 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr', 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.antpos'],
    gainfield = ['0', '', ''],
    interp = 'linear,linear',
    spwmap = [tsysmap,[],[]],
    calwt = T,
    flagbackup = F)
  
  
  
  applycal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    field = '1',
    spw = '9,11,13,15',
    gaintable = ['uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys', 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr', 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.antpos'],
    gainfield = ['1', '', ''],
    interp = 'linear,linear',
    spwmap = [tsysmap,[],[]],
    calwt = T,
    flagbackup = F)
  
  
  
  applycal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    field = '2~9',
    spw = '9,11,13,15',
    gaintable = ['uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.tsys', 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.wvr', 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.antpos'],
    gainfield = ['2', '', ''],
    interp = 'linear,linear',
    spwmap = [tsysmap,[],[]],
    calwt = T,
    flagbackup = F)
  
  if applyonly != True: es.getCalWeightStats('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms') 
  

# Split out science SPWs and time average
mystep = 8
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split') 
  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.flagversions') 
  split(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms',
    outputvis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    datacolumn = 'corrected',
    spw = '9,11,13,15',
    keepflags = T)
  
  

print "# Calibration"

# Listobs, clear pointing table, and save original flags
mystep = 9
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.listobs')
  listobs(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    listfile = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.listobs')
  
  tb.open('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split/POINTING', nomodify = False)
  a = tb.rownumbers()
  tb.removerows(a)
  tb.close()
  
  if not os.path.exists('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.flagversions/Original.flags'):
    flagmanager(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
      mode = 'save',
      versionname = 'Original')
  
  

# Initial flagging
mystep = 10
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  # Flagging shadowed data
  
  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    mode = 'shadow',
    flagbackup = F)
  
  # Flagging edge channels
  
  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    mode = 'manual',
    spw = '0:0~7;120~127,1:0~7;120~127,2:0~7;120~127,3:0~7;120~127',
    flagbackup = F)
  
   # Manual Flagging                                                                                      
  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
     antenna = 'DA53',
     flagbackup = F)

  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
     antenna = 'DV06,DA45',
     spw = '1,2,3',
     flagbackup = F)

  flagdata(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
     timerange='2014/12/30/10:43:42.0~2014/12/30/10:43:47.0',
     field = '1',
     flagbackup =F)

# Bandpass calibration
mystep = 13
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.ap_pre_bandpass') 
  
  gaincal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.ap_pre_bandpass',
    field = '0', # J1337-1257
    spw = '0:51~76,1:51~76,2:51~76,3:51~76',
    scan = '1,2,4,7,10,12,15,17,20,22',
    solint = 'int',
    refant = 'DA64',
    calmode = 'p')
  
  if applyonly != True: es.checkCalTable('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.ap_pre_bandpass', msName='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split', interactive=False) 
  
  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.bandpass') 
  bandpass(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.bandpass',
    field = '0', # J1337-1257
    scan = '1,2,4,7,10,12,15,17,20,22',
    solint = 'inf',
    combine = 'scan',
    refant = 'DA64',
    solnorm = True,
    bandtype = 'B',
    gaintable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.ap_pre_bandpass')
  
  if applyonly != True: es.checkCalTable('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.bandpass', msName='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split', interactive=False)

# Gain calibration
mystep = 15
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

    caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.ampli_inf',

    fluxtable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.flux_inf',
    reference = '1') # J1337-129
  
  casalog.setlogfile(mylogfile)
  
  if applyonly != True: es.fluxscale2(caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.ampli_inf', removeOutliers=True, msName='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms', writeToFile=True, preavg=10000)
  
  os.system('rm -rf uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.phase_inf') 
  gaincal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    caltable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.phase_inf',
    field = '0~1', # J1337-1257,J1337-129
    solint = 'inf',
    refant = 'DA64',
    gaintype = 'G',
    calmode = 'p',
    gaintable = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.bandpass')
  
  if applyonly != True: es.checkCalTable('uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split.phase_inf', msName='uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split', interactive=False)

# Application of the bandpass and gain cal tables
mystep = 17
if(mystep in thesteps):
  casalog.post('Step '+str(mystep)+' '+step_title[mystep],'INFO')
  print 'Step ', mystep, step_title[mystep]

  applycal(vis = 'uid___A002_X984bbe_X2df7.ms.split',
    field = '0', # RX_J1347.5-1145
   scan = '4',

    field = '0,3~9', # RX_J1347.5-1145
    scan = '7~22',

    calwt = T,
    flagbackup = F)
